tabf019q.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
tabf019q.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Snowy Scots Pine Christmas Tree
tabf019q.sourceDescription: Packed with character, the Snowy Scots Pine is one of our most charming trees. Unlike plain green Christmas trees, the Snowy Scots Pine comes with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches which draw the eye without stealing the show from your favourite festive decorations. The range is also the perfect choice for those unsure about going for a fully frosted Christmas tree. Where an all-over flocked tree could perhaps be a little too 'modern' for some tastes, the Snowy Scots Pine expertly balances the old with the new, providing a timeless artificial tree that all Christmas guests will adore. Picture shows 7ft tree in our range. And let's not forget the very best bit the Snowy Scots tree comes with pre-attached pine cones! It's this final festive flourish that makes it one of our most unique collections - and a favourite among the kids! Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 7ft • Number of Branch Tips: 1085 branch tips • Tree Width: 122cm diameter • Foliage colour: Green with light flocking and frosting • Realistic look: A stunning mix of PE/PVC and large bottle brush branch tips • Easy assembly: Attached hinged branches • Sturdy base: Folding metal stand with plastic tips to prevent scratching • Fire resistant: Fire retardancy certified • Indoor use only: The trees construction will rust in rain • Height measured from the floor • Picture shows 7ft Model • Eligible for European shipping • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom

njersbfz.baseName: My Christmas 4ft Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree with 320 Tips - White
njersbfz.variantName: My Christmas 4ft Snow Flocked Artificial Christmas Tree with 320 Tips - White
njersbfz.sourceDescription: Create a winter wonderland in your home with this snow-flocked artificial Christmas tree, featuring thick PVC branches covered in white flocking for a fresh, snowy appearance. Its full, well-spaced branches provide plenty of room for baubles, garlands and tree toppers, allowing you to personalise your festive display. Made with durable PVC foliage and a reinforced metal stand with padded feet, the tree offers reliable stability while helping protect your flooring. The segmented trunk and foldable base make assembly straightforward, while the collapsible sections allow convenient, space-saving storage after Christmas. Ideal for living rooms, lounges, offices and entryways, this tree brings seasonal charm to a variety of indoor spaces. Decorations are not included. Specifications: Made from durable, flame-retardant PVC with white snow-flocked branches and a reinforced metal stand with padded feet. Features a segmented trunk and foldable base for easy assembly and storage. Suitable for indoor Christmas decorating. Ornaments and decorations are not included. Dimensions: Height 120cm; diameter 80cm. Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG
